title: Associate Director, Clinical Pharmacology
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
Conceives, executes and effectively manages and communicates multi-disciplinary Clinical Pharmacology development plans and strategies that achieve commercial goals and regulatory requirements for multiple functions. Generates new PK/PD study proposals and leads those efforts. Anticipates and critically evaluates Clinical Pharmacology, PK/PD or regulatory advances, strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats, and responds with appropriate new strategies. Consistently demonstrates excellent record of accomplishment of Clinical Pharmacology and business objectives. Leads Clinical Pharmacology/PK/PD aspects of multiple projects. Responsible for critically evaluating technical and scientific aspects along with Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics management.
Responsibilities
Accountable for Phase 1-4 studies design, and clinical pharmacology strategy; acts as the representative for project(s).
Executes strategy, lead teams and various data analyses and interpretation by providing necessary context (including explaining MoA and disease specifics, available relevant internal and external data, analysis plans, interpretation and discussion of model results in the context of research question).
Author regulatory documents including protocols, study reports, population PK reports, exposure-response analyses reports, CTDs, label sections, relevant section of investigator brochures, white papers, and other similar documents.
Leads clinical pharmacology and biopharmaceutics meetings, serve as CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY representative at Clinical Strategy Team/Asset Development Team and present at various departmental and cross functional teams such as study teams, CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY leadership team, Journal club.
Drives small teams with members from CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY functional groups to provide a unified clinical pharmacology position to clinical, CMC and regulatory teams.
Authors scientific publications and present at national and international conferences and interact with KOLs/external stakeholders.
Conducts due diligence assessments, summarizes results and represents CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY on business development teams.
Represents Clinical Pharmacology at regulatory meetings.
PhD with typically 4+ years of experience or Pharm D with typically 6+ years of experience in a relevant field, Master’s Degree or equivalent education and typically 12+ years of experience, Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent education and typically 14+ years of experience;(*relevant field includes experience with PK, PBPK, PK-PD, Pharmacometrics or systems pharmacology, Drug metabolism/Transporters)
Excellent interpersonal skills
Ability to interact with functional representatives and KOLs externally and internally and lead team(s)
Strategic thinking and enterprise view
Proven scientific track record and technical skills to perform the role
Key Leadership Competencies:
• Delivers business results while also positioning AbbVie for long-term success
• Persistent and resilient finds the way to move good ideas forward
• Acts respectfully yet courageously
• Connects unrelated concepts, generates original or unique ideas
• Influences colleagues to achieve cross-functional alignment
• Gives full accountability when delegating and accepts full accountability when delegated to by others

Purpose
The Associate Director, Customs Valuation Compliance & Reporting, is a critical compliance role that actively partners across the enterprise and leads the operations and strategic design of the end-to-end customs valuation and reconciliation process.  Responsibilities include leading the financial planning and reporting of customs tariff impact to AbbVie’s imports (primarily focused on the Americas region) by conducting relevant variance analyses, scenario modeling and developing executive-ready reports; leading customs valuation initiatives in collaboration with stakeholders from other departments; and ensuring accuracy and predictability of tariff costs and other customs reporting metrics.

Ensure compliance with U.S. Customs and Border Protection laws and regulations in the areas of customs valuation reporting
Lead QA / data integrity work in partnership with key cross functional partners (e.g.  Tax, Corporate Accounting, Operations Controller Team, Supply Chain)
Lead scenario planning and modeling collaboratively with key stakeholders to identify tariff costs of various levels of the supply chain that will contribute to production planning decisions
Develop opportunities to utilize technology and enhance existing processes related to declaring and reporting final customs values through the reconciliation process
Develop and manage the program governance and controls for key trade program strategies for AbbVie
Primary SME on the review of contracts to determine potential customs valuation considerations (e.g., royalties)
Manage resource(s) supporting the existing customs valuation processes and strategies
Participate in governance forums and interface with various levels of leadership
Advise and support cross-functional activities as new tariff regulations are enacted

Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting, CPA or MBA a plus
Minimum [7+] years of leadership experience, including Operations / Supply Chain Finance
Proficiency in SAP (S4/Hana) module expertise particularly in Finance and Controlling and Materials Management
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint are essential

Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to make data-driven decisions
Demonstrated cross-functional leadership skills
Superior organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to recognize opportunities to simplify processes and create efficiencies
Highly adaptable to new information and shifting priorities; demonstrated ability to multitask
Strong executive-ready communication skills

MBA or advanced degree
International or global work experience

Solid business judgment capable of driving a diverse organization to the right results with a focused, pragmatic approach
Builds strong cross-functional relationships with business partners and geographically dispersed team members to enable higher performance
Demonstrated “executive presence” and ability to represent team in a professional manner with Senior Leadership
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment; adaptable to last-minute changes in requirements or priorities
Advanced analytical and process diagnostic skills and the ability to get into the details, while also understanding and driving the full team to achieve results in line with the “big picture” objectives
Learns fast, grasps the 'essence' and can change course quickly
Ability to make solid decisions with minimal information
Conflict resolution capabilities, particularly in finding common ground for win/win solutions in a matrixed environment
Strong interpersonal skills — including written and oral communication skills
Ability to deliver feedback, recognizing strong performance, and also recognizing when corrective action would benefit individual and group performance with kindness
Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines while managing multiple priorities
Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information

description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. The Associate Director, Statistics provides statistical leadership for clinical development and life-cycle management strategies for assigned projects. Specific areas of work may include clinical trials, patient safety, and global medical affairs. The Associate Director works in partnership with experts in multiple disciplines to advance medicines to our patients.
Responsibilities:
Provide expertise/lead regulatory submission and product life-cycle management strategy planning and implementation for assigned projects. Provide statistical leadership for design, analysis and reporting for clinical or other scientific research programs. Independently develop protocols and statistical analysis plans (or product safety analysis plans/integrated summary of safety analysis plans/analysis plans for GMA evidence generation).
Represent function/department on project team(s) to provide statistical input to compound/drug development and drive alignment with functional management. Partner with other functions (Clinical, Regulatory, Patient Safety, or GMA) to create development strategies for assigned projects.
Demonstrate extensive understanding of statistical concepts and methodology. Propose novel statistical methodological approaches to design of scientific studies. Provide sufficient detail to allow programming implementation. Ensure that all statistical analyses specified in scientific protocols and analysis plans are conducted appropriately.
Train and mentor staff on statistical methodology and operations. May supervise contract statisticians or junior statisticians. Gain expertise in innovative statistical methods. Assist functional leaders in recruiting qualified personnel and arranging training opportunities for professional development of staff.
Develop strategy for data presentation and inference. Ensure appropriate interpretation of statistical deliverables in collaboration with other functions. Collaborate in publication of scientific research. Ensure accuracy and internal consistency of reports and publications, including tables, listings, and figures.
Act as the liaison for statistical issues on AbbVie collaborative studies with CROs, academic institutions, government agencies, steering and/or data monitoring committees, joint ventures or licensing collaborators. Build external scientific connections which foster professional development and promote the reputation of the Statistics department.
Ensure that all applicable regulatory requirements for work processes are met. Critically review regulatory submission documents. Participate in discussions with regulatory agencies as needed. Validate external statistical software to ensure compliance with SOPs and regulatory requirements.
Minimum Qualifications:
MS (with 10+ years of experience) or PhD (with 6+ years of experience) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a highly related field.
Have strong leadership skills and experience in working/managing cross-cultural or oversea teams
Pharmaceutical  knowledge required, including experience and understanding of drug development and life-cycle management in the regulated environment.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with late-stage clinical trials and/or submissions
Experience with immunology clinical trials
Other Required Skills:
High degree of technical competence and excellent communication skills, both oral and written
Able to identify data or analytical issues, and assist with providing solutions by either applying own skills and knowledge or seeking help from others
Able to manage project timeline and quality of deliverables
Able to build strong relationship with peers and cross-functional partners to achieve higher performance. Highly motivated to drive innovation by raising the bar and challenging the status quo

Overview
The Development Sciences Biologics Drug Product Development organization within AbbVie develops and characterizes drug product formulations and manufacturing processes to provide clinical dosage forms to enable the development of AbbVie’s pipeline. AbbVie is seeking a highly motivated person to join the Biologics CMC Developability Team. Our team utilizes state-of-the-art biophysical and analytical instrumentation to assess candidates coming out of the Discovery pipeline. We collaboratively influence protein design paradigms to yield biologic candidates that will be successful drug products. Key to our success is developing models of protein structure and function to augment decision making in protein design and development. We utilize high throughput instrumentation and digital data systems to capture ML-ready data on industry leading datasets of therapeutic proteins. To drive maximum benefit from this data, we are seeking an experienced scientist to lead modeling efforts within our team. The successful candidate will bring deep experience of modeling protein stability or related properties to solve foundational questions such as viscosity, chemical degradation, and aggregation. Direct experience with applying modeling techniques (mechanistic or statistical) to protein long-term stability or formulation screening such as kinetic degradation modeling

Familiar with complex ML architectures including deep learning and hierarchical or multi-task frameworks
Skilled with feature attribution, sensitivity analysis, and model interpretability

Excellent oral communication skills in a scientific setting as well as sound technical writing and documentation competencies are required.

Establish, maintain and deploy global engineering standards, technical practices and governance expectations for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery.
Drive consistent application of technical standards, design principles, lessons learned and engineering playbooks across regions, sites and capital projects.
Define enterprise standards, engineering requirements and technical guardrails for new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technologies, including requirements for consistent design, deployment, qualification, operation and scale-up across Strategic Investments.
Ensure discipline strategies support AbbVie’s long-range Strategic Investment objectives, strategic investment programs and adoption of new technologies across future manufacturing platforms.
Provide governance and escalation for technical decisions with material safety, quality, compliance, cost, schedule, operability or lifecycle impact.
Strategic New Technology and Capital Investment Support
Provide engineering leadership for strategic capital investments, including new biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy facility builds, technology platform deployments, new production capabilities, strategic capacity projects and lifecycle technology upgrades.
Support front-end engineering, facility concept development, investment option evaluation, manufacturing capability assessments and site / platform planning activities for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy assets.
Partner with Strategic Investments and project leadership to ensure technical assumptions, deliverables, risks and resource needs are integrated into capital program plans.
Apply Strategic Investment lessons learned and standards to improve project quality, speed, reliability and readiness across the portfolio.
Technical Leadership and Delivery
Lead or support technical decision-making for biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process engineering strategy, process platform deployment, process package design, technical assurance, manufacturing technology interfaces and project delivery across multiple manufacturing sites, capital projects and technology platforms.
Ensure engineering deliverables support safety, quality, compliance, operability, maintainability, reliability, sustainability and operational readiness.
Coordinate technical input from project teams, site SMEs, external engineering partners, vendors and cross-functional stakeholders.
Drive timely resolution of technical issues and ensure suitable escalation when decisions have broader project, network or business impact.

Partner with Strategic Investments, manufacturing operations, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, site engineering, MS&T, supply chain, finance and related engineering disciplines.
Ensure discipline decisions are integrated with biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing strategy, network capacity, technology platform deployment, regulatory expectations and site handover needs.
Facilitate collaboration across Strategic Investments, sites and project teams to avoid fragmented solutions and drive consistency across the strategic capital portfolio.
Represent Strategic Investment in technical reviews, project forums and risk discussions relevant to assigned scope.
Capability Building and Continuous Improvement
Share engineering best practices, lessons learned and technical knowledge across sites, regions and projects.
Build capability through coaching, mentoring, technical review discipline and development of reusable engineering practices.
Promote a culture of engineering excellence, safety, quality, reliability, collaboration, accountability and proactive risk management.
Support continuous improvement of Strategic Investment standards, templates, knowledge management and project delivery approaches.

Collaborate across Strategic Investments to identify, develop and deploy best practices, technical standards, lessons learned and capability-building initiatives.
Promote consistency, quality, reliability, sustainability and project delivery performance across regions, sites and capital projects.
Support long-range manufacturing strategy, strategic investment planning and Strategic Investment capability development.
Build technical capability through coaching, mentoring, standards governance, knowledge management and cross-functional collaboration.

Strategic Investments: Investment planning, portfolio alignment, technical assumptions, front-end engineering, biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy technology deployment standards and strategic capital program support.

Quality, Validation / CQV and EHS:  Compliance expectations, validation strategy, qualification readiness, safety, risk review and inspection readiness interfaces.
Strategic Investment Disciplines:  Cross-discipline technical integration, standards, design reviews, technical issue resolution and lessons learned.
External Engineering Partners, EPCM Firms, Vendors and OEMs : Technical oversight, deliverable review, issue escalation, supplier alignment and execution quality.

Experience supporting biologics drug substance, cell therapy, gene therapy, viral vector, mRNA, sterile biologics or similarly regulated biopharmaceutical manufacturing environments preferred.
Demonstrated ability to work across global functions, manufacturing sites, project teams, suppliers, vendors and external engineering partners.
Strong communication, risk management, technical judgment, stakeholder engagement and structured problem-solving skills.
Technical Competencies
Biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy process design and process package review
Front-end engineering and concept development
Biologics and CGT technology transfer, platform deployment and manufacturing scale-up
Process safety and CQV interfaces
Strategic Investment support
Strategic capital investment and new biologics / CGT technology deployment support
Engineering governance and standards
Development of engineering standards and deployment requirements for emerging biologics drug substance and cell and gene therapy manufacturing technologies
Technical understanding of bioreactor, harvest, purification, single-use, closed processing, aseptic processing, viral vector, cell processing and cryogenic / cold-chain interfaces as applicable to biologics and CGT platforms
Technical risk management
Project execution support
Stakeholder management
Vendor / partner technical coordination
GMP and regulated manufacturing awareness
Operational readiness and handover support

Strategic thinking and enterprise mindset
Matrix leadership and influence without direct authority

Risk-based decision making and issue escalation

Lead, coach and develop a high-performing technical engineering team with clear priorities, accountability, development plans and delivery expectations aligned to Strategic Investment objectives.
Set technical direction for the engineering team, ensuring work is prioritized against safety, quality, compliance, business value, capital delivery needs and long-range manufacturing strategy.
Build technical bench strength by identifying capability gaps, developing succession depth, mentoring senior engineers and enabling knowledge transfer across sites, projects and technology platforms.

title: Senior Enablement Manager - API
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join
The Enterprise Operations organization is instrumental in powering Airbnb's growth and expansion at a global scale. Through AI- and people-powered operations, this team maximizes the effectiveness, utilization, and impact of our supply, ensuring hosts and guests can seamlessly connect.
The Supply Enablement & Activation team is a horizontal Center of Excellence within Enterprise Operations, serving as a strategic partner to global field and vendor teams by driving standardized strategy, tools, and best practices at scale. We turn our supply strategy into repeatable, scalable, best in class enablement deliverables – collateral, training, tools & workflows, and comms/change management -- for our sales & operator teams across each line of business: Homes, Hotels, Experiences & Services.
This role supports the API team, which sits at the heart of Airbnb's Supply strategy, managing the connectivity partners — property management software providers, channel managers, and distribution platforms — that power a significant share of our global inventory. These partnerships unlock access to millions of listings and directly shape the quality and reliability of the host and guest experience.
At the center of this work are our Connectivity Partner Managers, who own Airbnb's relationships with these third-party technology providers — PMS (Property Management System), channel manager, and revenue management tool vendors that hosts and property managers use to sync listings, calendars, pricing, and reservations with Airbnb. Connectivity Partner Managers are the primary point of contact for these partners: they ensure integrations meet Airbnb's connectivity standards, resolve sync and data issues, onboard new partners, negotiate partnership terms, drive adoption of Airbnb's APIs among software vendors, and work with Product and Engineering to prioritize roadmap improvements based on partner feedback.
The Difference You Will Make
We're looking for a seasoned Senior Enablement Manager to build and own end-to-end enablement for Airbnb's API team and Connectivity Partner Managers across AMER, EMEA, and APAC. This is a newly approved, full-time role created to close a resourcing gap: enablement support for API has historically been covered informally and part-time, and this role will stand up a sustainable, scalable enablement function from the ground up.
The core of this role is to enable our Connectivity Partner Managers to do their jobs more effectively and drive tangible impact. Connectivity Partner Managers own the full relationship with PMS, channel manager, and revenue management tool partners — from onboarding and integration standards to sync/data issue resolution, contract negotiation, API adoption, and roadmap prioritization with Product and Engineering. You will build the onboarding curriculum, training, playbooks, and certifications that ramp new Connectivity Partner Managers; keep them current on product launches, API versions, and roadmap changes; and equip them with the narratives, tools, and processes they need to manage partner relationships and escalations with confidence.
This is a highly cross-functional, more technical role than a typical field-enablement position — it requires deep, ongoing engagement with the Product roadmap and with Connectivity Partner Managers themselves, not a copy-paste of a direct-sales enablement playbook. You will own onboarding, training, and continuous development for teams supporting API partners; drive consistent acquisition, growth, and retention of high-quality supply; and localize global enablement programs for regional relevance. You'll partner cross-functionally to collect and share feedback, and use enablement tools and insights to continuously improve outcomes.
A Typical Day

description:
What does security look like when AI agents are writing and rewriting the software behind one of the world's largest retail businesses? Point-in-time reviews can't keep up, and continuous visibility becomes the foundation. Amazon Stores Security protects the systems, data and customers behind Amazon's Stores business. We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own our Observability program. The program gives Amazon a clear, current picture of the systems we run and how they behave, and turns that picture into security insights people can act on.
In this role, you'll set long-term direction for one of the most complex programs in Stores Security. You'll lead a broad set of engineering, science and security partner teams, influence senior leaders, and make sure security keeps up with how fast Amazon builds. If you love ambiguous, large-scale technical problems where the right answer protects customers, this role is for you.
Key job responsibilities
- Own strategy and delivery end-to-end: Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for security observability across a large, varied technology landscape. Turn ambitious goals into clear, executable plans with measurable outcomes.
- Make security visibility the default: Partner with developer tooling and platform teams so security visibility is built in from the start, not added by builders after the fact.
- Expand visibility across a diverse environment: Drive programs that extend visibility to cloud services, corporate and operational devices, third-party relationships and newly integrated businesses.
- Turn data into action: Lead work that turns large volumes of security data into accurate, prioritized signals. Build the mechanisms that measure signal quality and help teams fix issues faster, with more automation over time.
- Prepare security for AI agents: Help shape how Amazon observes and governs AI agents as they become a bigger part of how software gets built and run.
- Drive technical depth, not just coordination: Go deep enough to challenge tradeoffs in large-scale data systems, detection approaches, machine learning and agentic architectures. Know where the real risks hide.
- Balance impact and cost: Make data-driven decisions about scale, cost and efficiency for a program with significant infrastructure needs.
- Communicate like a strategist: Write clear planning docs, business reviews and executive communications that drive alignment and decisions across many organizations.
- Anticipate, mitigate, accelerate: Manage complex cross-team dependencies and surface risks early. Use risk management to prioritize, not paralyze.
- Use AI to move faster: Use AI tools to speed up planning, combine status across teams and shorten the time from insight to action.
- Raise the bar: Mentor TPMs, set standards for how large security programs are run, and shape how Stores Security delivers at scale.
A day in the life
You might start your morning adjusting a delivery plan based on a new signal about how fast agent-driven development is growing. Then you jump into an architecture review where your risk instincts meet a principal engineer's design (and something better emerges). After lunch, you're leading an executive review, working through tradeoffs between speed, accuracy and cost in real time. title: Americas Logistics- Delivery Exception Manager
description:
Every Apple product is a promise to a customer. When that promise breaks somewhere between our dock and their door, we find out why, and we make sure it doesn't happenagain. The AMR Delivery Exception Management (DEM) team protects Apple's customers and bottom line by turning exception, loss, and claims trends into lasting fixes across our carrier network. We are looking for a strategic leader who looks beyond today's cases, using trend analysis to anticipate where losses will occur and driving the process andcommercial changes that prevent them across the Americas network.
You will own the DEM strategy and roadmap for the Americas, lead a team of analysts, and represent DEM with senior leaders across Logistics, Finance, Product Security,AppleCare, and our carrier partners. You will lead the business side of a next-generation platform that automates investigations and standardizes how exceptions are handled,using it to shift the team's capacity from case work to prevention. If you build strong teams, follow the data to the root cause, and can change minds in difficult conversations,we'd love to hear from you!
Own the Americas DEM strategy, multi-year roadmap, and results for exception management, carrier claims and recovery, and loss investigations, including budget,methods, and staffing.
Set operating objectives, performance standards, and a tiered review cadence for exceptions, claims, and loss, with clear owners and success criteria.
Own exception, claims, and credit policies that affect DEM and the wider Apple logistics network, and make the call on DEM operational decisions and escalations.
Define and publish the DEM scorecard, including exception rate, loss and credit exposure, claims recovery, claim cycle time, and repeat defects.
Shift the team from reactive case resolution to predictive, upstream prevention, using trend analysis to anticipate emerging risks and building fixes into process, policy,training, and carrier commercial terms.
Lead carrier performance and commercial management, including quarterly business reviews, recovery targets, claims settlement and liability terms, and joint data visibility.
Partner with Product Security on high-value shipment risk, theft and loss trends, carrier vetting, and freight security controls.
Own a next-generation exception management platform and automation roadmap from the business side. You will connect data across order, shipment, carrier, claims, andservice systems, drive adoption across sites and carriers, and lead ongoing enhancements.
Serve as DEM's point of contact for Logistics Operations, Finance, AppleCare, Reseller, Retail, and carrier partners, and represent DEM in senior management and executivereviews, bringing recommendations and decisions, not just performance updates.
Lead DEM readiness for peak events such as New Product Introductions and Order By Deliver By, and partner with Inventory Control on shared root causes andcross-coverage.
Hire, develop, and coach analysts, building bench strength through cross-training and rotation, and growing senior analysts to lead work streams.
What Success Looks Like (6 to 12 Months)
-A consistent review cadence runs with clear owners and documented root-cause closure.
-The weekly DEM scorecard shows measurable improvement in loss exposure, claims recovery, and repeat defects.
-At least one top recurring failure mode has been fixed upstream through a process or commercial change with a carrier or logistics partner.
-The next-generation platform is delivered on plan, and automation is returning measurable analyst hours to prevention work.
-The team operates as one cross-trained Americas function, with documented SOPs and a development plan for every team member.
-You are DEM's senior leader for the Americas, owning strategy, executive reviews, carrier escalations, and the platform roadmap from start to finish.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
10 or more years of experience in Transportation, Supply Chain, Logistics, or Operations, including 5 or more years of people leadership.
Proven experience leading logistics or supply chain operations teams, ideally in delivery exception management, carrier claims, loss prevention, or freight security.
Track record of setting strategy and objectives, managing budgets and staffing, and running multi-site or multi-carrier programs with clear cadence and governance.
Deep end-to-end knowledge of inbound, outbound, forward, and reverse logistics, and of how carrier, claims, and service processes connect.
Strong data judgment, using trend analysis to anticipate risk, find root causes, and quantify financial exposure, with comfort reviewing technical queries and BI dashboards.
Experience negotiating commercial terms with carriers or vendors, such as claims settlement, liability, or service-level agreements.
Executive-level communication skills and the ability to influence senior leaders, carriers, and partners in sensitive situations while preserving the relationship.
Preferred qualifications: MBA or advanced degree.
Experience leading automation, agentic workflows, or systems integration projects with IT, from requirements through adoption.
Lean Six Sigma or equivalent continuous improvement experience.
Background supporting Reseller, Retail, and Online channels across a multi-DC footprint.
Familiarity with inventory control or reconciliation.

title: Tribologist
description:
Apple's Product Design Materials Engineering team designs and specifies materials used in every Apple product, from metals, glass, and ceramics to composites, polymers, adhesives, and coatings. Every surface that moves, slides, or touches shapes how an Apple product feels and performs, and we're growing our team with a dedicated tribology expert to help define how we design, test, and qualify materials for these interfaces.
We are looking for a senior tribologist to be our team's expert on friction, wear, and lubrication. You will work in our Materials Development Center in Santa Clara, CA. There you'll combine a strong theoretical foundation with practical experimental judgment to shape how Apple designs and qualifies materials for moving interfaces, and to help keep those interfaces working well for customers over years of use.
You will set the technical direction for tribology across Apple's product lines by identifying the friction and wear mechanisms that govern performance and defining test strategies (from coupon-level screening to component-level validation) that match real-world use. You will lead in-depth tribological characterization and failure analysis, working with the lab's broader characterization specialists to identify the wear mechanisms at work and determine root cause. You'll turn these learnings into actionable design choices: material, coating, and lubrication specifications, contact and geometry recommendations, and qualification criteria that product teams can apply with confidence. You will also expand and advance the lab's tribology capability and train and mentor technicians to run routine measurements.
Minimum qualifications: Masters or PhD in Materials Science, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, with research focused on tribology or surface science
5+ years of industry experience applying tribology to product development, ideally for mechanical components or consumer hardware
Deep expertise in tribology fundamentals, including contact mechanics, friction, and wear mechanisms in metals, ceramics, polymers, and coated surfaces, with the ability to identify wear mechanisms from worn surfaces and failure analysis results
Proven ability to design and interpret coupon-level tribology tests, link the results to component and field performance, and use them to drive material and coating selection
Preferred qualifications: Expertise in surface engineering and coatings for wear-critical interfaces, such as PVD/CVD and DLC coatings, nitriding, anodizing, and other surface treatments, including their effect on scratch and cosmetic wear
Strong knowledge of lubrication, including boundary lubrication, damping greases, solid lubricants, and how lubricants interact with nearby materials
Experience with polymer and elastomer tribology, including self-lubricating polymers, bushings, and seals
Experience working with simulation or modeling teams to turn contact mechanics and wear theory into predictive models
Understanding of tribocorrosion and environmental effects on wear, such as humidity, temperature, and exposure to sweat, skin oils, and cosmetics
Experience designing custom tribology test rigs, including test methods, data handling, and analysis, and building lab capability through equipment specification and internal test standards
A record of mentoring technicians and engineers, communicating clearly with cross-functional partners, and contributing to the field through publications or professional societies such as STLE

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4+ years of experience in manufacturing program management, manufacturing engineering, equipment engineering, or new product introduction (NPI)

From launching new production lines to introducing equipment and processes, the team solves the technical and operational challenges of scaling U.S. manufacturing. Summary:
As a Business Analysis Manager at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You'll team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.
General Responsibilities:
Strategic leadership: Develop business strategies that will drive growth, profitability, and competitive success for Capital One in the face of shifting consumer and regulatory demands
Leadership: May manage and develop 1-2 analysts. Coaching and mentoring associates with a goal of developing and retaining talent at Capital One
Product: Develop and implement new product and pricing strategies for various lending products; lead product level modeling/analytics
Marketing: Lead direct-to-consumer marketing efforts for select products, and strategic intent for products distributed through the retail channel. Build targeted insights to inform the design and development of new customer experiences, as well as breakthrough technology and concepts designed to deliver on new go-to-market strategies
Credit Risk: Drive step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer credit trends to historical behavior, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysis
Execution: Manage and sequence delivery of business intent, build business requirements and execute against the product strategy. Oversee multiple projects and programs concurrently
Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including: IT, Sales, Operations, Finance and others to drive improvement in quality, volume, service, and profitability
Strategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytic marketing & credit risk management
Strong business judgment, leadership and integrity: He/she should be a tenacious decision maker, able to bring a healthy, aggressive, yet responsible approach to business
Solid people leadership experience: Ability to build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team, as well as business partners across the enterprise. He/she should foster innovation, drive critical decisions, hold business partners accountable, and be able to consistently deliver results
Strong executive communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills
Clear results orientation: display an intense focus on achieving both short and long term goals. He/she should be able to drive and execute an agenda in an uncertain and fluid environment
Successful track record of thriving in a fast paced, entrepreneurial and dynamic environment. Previous consulting experience is a plus
Basic Qualifications:
At least 3 years of professional experience performing analysis
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date: A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer engineering, Software engineering, Mechanical engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field)
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Information Systems or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications:
Master’s Degree in Business or quantitative field such as Finance, Economics, Physical Sciences, Math, Statistics, Engineering
5+ years of experience in analysis
2+ years of experience in financial services
1+ year of experience in consulting
2+ years of experience in people management

Month of Hire: Prorated guarantee up to $750

We are currently accepting applicants at all levels. Please see the minimum requirements for each level of the role below.
Job Description (Applies to All Levels)
The Mobile Inspector functions as a key member of the Manheim Mobile Inspections team, responsible for conducting on‑site vehicle condition inspections for dealer clients within an assigned territory. This role provides accurate, detailed, and timely documentation of vehicle condition in accordance with Manheim inspection standards, supporting client trust, marketplace transparency, and inventory flow.
Mobile Inspectors build strong relationships with dealer clients by delivering consistent, high‑quality inspections, acting as brand ambassadors for Cox Automotive, and actively engaging dealers to grow participation in Manheim’s mobile inspection services.
This role requires the ability to work with minimal supervision while demonstrating increasing independence, sound judgment, and problem‑solving skills.
Primary Responsibilities & Essential Functions
Vehicle Inspection & Documentation
Conduct thorough vehicle inspections in accordance with Manheim inspection standards.
Locate, start, move, inspect, and return vehicles safely on dealer client lots.
Verify vehicle identification, VINs, mileage, sub‑series, and options; ensure accurate system entry.
Inspect and document vehicle exterior condition, including tires, frame, glass, panels, and mechanical components.
Inspect and document interior condition, including seating, dashboard, and installed options.
Perform basic mechanical checks across powertrain, drivetrain, and electrical components.
Identify and document damage, missing components, or inoperable features.
Client Engagement & Territory Management
Build trust with dealer clients through consistent quality, professionalism, and responsiveness.

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
Job Description:
As a Tax Manager, you will provide tax consulting, planning, and compliance services to a diverse client base within the real estate and construction industries. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them navigate complex tax matters, identify planning opportunities, and achieve their business objectives. You will work closely with clients and engagement teams to deliver high-quality service while contributing to the growth and success of the practice.
This position offers the opportunity to develop meaningful client relationships, lead multiple engagements, mentor team members, and play a key role in delivering strategic tax solutions. The ideal candidate is a proactive leader with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to providing an exceptional client experience.
Responsibilities:
Provide tax consulting, planning, and compliance services to clients in the real estate and construction industries.
Perform tax research and analysis to address complex client issues and identify tax-saving opportunities.
Develop and implement tax planning strategies tailored to clients' business objectives.
Manage and review tax calculations, returns, and related work products to ensure accuracy and compliance.
Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, building and maintaining strong relationships through responsive and proactive service.
Lead multiple client engagements simultaneously while ensuring quality, efficiency, and timely delivery.
Collaborate with engagement teams to identify, address, and resolve client challenges.
Anticipate client needs and provide strategic guidance on emerging tax issues and opportunities.
Mentor, coach, and develop staff in a collaborative and team-oriented environment.
Contribute to practice growth through business development efforts and the expansion of existing client relationships.
​
Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Accounting required; Master's in Taxation, LLM, or related advanced degree preferred.
CPA license required.
Minimum of 5 years of public accounting tax experience, with a focus on real estate and construction clients.
Experience with real estate partnership taxation strongly preferred.
Demonstrated success managing client relationships and leading tax engagements.
Strong technical tax knowledge, including tax research and planning.
Proven ability to identify and resolve complex client issues while delivering practical solutions.
Experience developing and expanding client relationships.
Strong leadership, project management, and staff development skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and team members at all levels.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
#LI-Hybrid
We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,500.00 - $195,400.00 per year.
This role follows a hybrid work model for candidates located near a Crowe office. Candidates who are not within commuting distance of a Crowe office may be considered for a remote work arrangement, subject to business needs.
Our Benefits:
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
How You Can Grow:
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
More about Crowe:
Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services.
The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world.* As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide.

title: Assistant Site Manager, DashMart - [Charlotte, NC]
description:
About the Team
DashMart is a local-fulfillment center owned and operated by DoorDash, offering customers household essentials and other items to their doorsteps with speed, reliability, and quality.
About the Role
In this role, you’ll work within a 5-15k sq ft distribution center, will assist in leading the local warehouse operating team, and in some locations, includes preparing food in a light-prep kitchen, and help the Site Manager ensure we maintain high quality for our customers.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Lead: You’ll demonstrate compassion and commitment to inclusivity as you lead a team of hourly Operations Associates and Shift Leads. You’ll hire, coach and develop high-performing team members, while building a safety-first culture where employees are excited to drive success, personally and for the team. You’ll serve as a leading change agent for your site, helping your team to navigate new initiatives and growth projects. You’ll tackle onsite escalations, including coordination with cross-functional partners.
Operate: With your thumb on the pulse of all outcomes for your team, you will be directly responsible for driving results in one or more specific focus areas or a specific shift for your site. To achieve your performance targets, you’ll drive success through effective scheduling and by executing inventory management processes and deploying best practices from across the network. You’ll engage cross-functional partners as needed for support.
Strategize: Within the focus area(s) assigned by your Site Manager, you’ll analyze data and make strategic recommendations and execute actions regarding resource allocation, workflow, warehouse organization and when to engage cross-functional partners. You may also lead some process improvement projects.
Delight: We are customer-obsessed. You’ll coach and empower your team to provide a highly quality customer experience with every order. Quality metrics such as order accuracy and fulfillment speed will be key measurements of success for your team. You’ll also work cross-functionally with central teams from our inventory to training teams to ensure your team has the tools and resources they’ll need to deliver.
We’re excited about you because…
You’re a proven leader. You have managed high-performance teams of 5+ employees with successful performance and employee development outcomes.
You relish ownership. You’re excited to have ownership in a new and rapidly growing business. No problem is too big or too small for you, and you’re ready to show up however needed for your team.
You solve problems from first principles.   You’re excited to solve problems in innovative ways, and you resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.
You’re unafraid of ambiguity.   Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you thrive in ambiguous, startup environments.
You’re analytical . You let data win arguments. You are a data-first problem solver and you have experience using Excel or Google Sheets to analyze data, including using basic formulas and creating pivot tables.
You have 3+ years’ experience : In Operations, Warehouse Logistics, Customer Service, Retail Management, Fulfillment, or related field
You have 1+ years of experience managing a team
You have flexibility in your schedule. As the leader of the site, you will need to ensure your team and the site is fully supported, which will include regularly scheduled late-night and weekend hours.

description:
About the Team
Our US Marketplace Strategy & Operations team is responsible for building, scaling and improving the way in which we provide Restaurant delivery. We build our restaurant selection, test 0 → 1 products to give merchants more opportunity to delight their consumers, and optimize ways to improve our marketplace to increase the return on investment our partners gain from partnering with DoorDash. This team focuses on all things Restaurants ranging from selection, to merchandising, to consumer strategy, to leveraging our logistics network in new ways, to so much more!
About the Role
We are seeking an Associate Manager to join our Marketplace Strategy & Operations team, with a focus on Restaurant Growth. This team is dedicated to growing our restaurant marketplace by launching new selection, enhancing in-app merchandising, helping negotiate new merchant partnerships, and commercializing products that help our restaurant partners grow their businesses on DoorDash. In this role, you will define and execute DoorDash’s restaurant strategy, creating sustainable value for restaurants, consumers, and Dashers while unlocking incremental marketplace revenue.
The ideal candidate will possess a growth mindset, strong analytical skills, and a deep sense of ownership. If you're excited about launching 0 to 1 projects, solving customer challenges, working in fast-paced environments, and managing a marketplace business line with broad impact, this role is for you.

Operate. You’ll become an expert on running a sustainable marketplace business — creating value for merchants, Dashers, and consumers alike.
We’re excited about you because…
You have 4-6+ years of experience in a problem-solving role (consulting, tech, banking).
You have an extreme sense of ownership — you never shy away from tackling ambiguous problems and can motivate teammates to go above and beyond.
You solve problems from first principles and resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.
You thrive with a diverse set of responsibilities and love working across teams and disciplines.
You’re an analytical powerhouse — you let data win arguments and are comfortable pulling your own data in SQL and modeling in Excel.

About the Team
DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager with a strong platform mindset to lead the Order Platform Checkout team. This team’s mission is to deliver reliable, feature-rich, and extensible platform services that power seamless customer experiences, enabling frictionless order completion. This is a chance to lead a high-impact platform team with real company leverage and help shape the long-term foundation for DoorDash ordering at global scale.
About the Role
As the Engineering Manager for the Order Platform Checkout team, you will lead a team of talented and driven backend engineers in building impactful features and scalable platforms. You will partner closely with engineering teams across the organization to deliver on a strategic roadmap that strengthens the platform’s foundation and elevates customer satisfaction. Through your leadership, you will ensure the creation of robust, reliable systems that enable best-in-class products and technological innovation.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Be the technologist and system thinker who connects the dots between technology to the business and unlocks business opportunities through tech innovation

Provide architectural guidance and professional development for a team of 8+
Encourage innovation, teamwork, implementation of cutting-edge technologies, and outside-of-the-box thinking

We’re excited about you because you have…
B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science or related field
2+ years of experience in people management leading backend teams
7+ years of industry experience
Strong product sense and can be a thought partner with cross-functional peers
Deep platform expertise and dedication to engineering craftsmanship
A customer-centric mindset and will apply that to building out platform services
Growth mindset - you're eager to expand your skill set and excited to carve out your career path in a hyper-growth setting
Adaptability, resiliency, and ability to thrive in ambiguity - things can change quickly, and you'll need to help the team evolve
Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash
We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies
We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day
We are learning - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, whether we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute
We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights

title: Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator
description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We explore robotics and automation to transform last mile logistics in the long term. If you want to work on commercializing autonomy and robotics in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!
About the Role
We’re looking for an Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator to own how our DoorDash Labs sites run day to day and to follow every issue through to done. As the tier 2 layer between our front desk and procurement/inventory teams, you’ll triage the request queue, run equipment transport, manage vendor and facilities follow-up, host visitors and events, and coordinate onboarding as the team grows.
You’ll work closely with Front Desk, Procurement & Inventory, Workplace, Facilities, Finance, and engineering teams to keep our sites safe, organized, and ready as the team roughly doubles next year.
The Operations Specialist - Office Coordinator will report to the Supply Chain Lead.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own the equipment transport queue (EOS / drones): set priorities, schedule pickups, track every request in Jira, and manage no-shows across sites
Triage the daily request queue, making small calls independently and escalating larger decisions (e.g., security, construction, AV)
Own tickets and follow-up with Workplace, landlords, and service vendors (cleaning, pest, dumpster, repairs, ServiceChannel), and maintain a weekly open-issues list
Walk each site regularly (gate, dumpster, kitchen, restrooms, common areas), log issues, and track corrective work through completion
Plan and run hosting: catering orders, demo-day logistics, visitor and event prep, rooms, and shuttles
Own the new hire onboarding checklist (desk, badge, access, equipment, orientation) and track desk counts as the team grows
Initiate site-level requests (e.g., furniture, desks, cabinets) and hand off to Procurement & Inventory for purchase
Take over contractor contract renewals, contractor onboarding, and Coupa processes, including a backlog of contractors expiring at year end
Partner with Front Desk, Procurement & Inventory, and Facilities to build repeatable playbooks that can be reused across sites
We’re excited about you because…
You have 3+ years of experience in office management, facilities coordination, workplace operations, or operations coordination across one or more sites
You are highly organized and own follow-through — nothing falls through the cracks until it is closed
You have strong communication and interpersonal skills, and are comfortable managing vendors, landlords, and internal stakeholders

title: Senior Purchasing Operations Associate
description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION



As Form transforms the grid, we are looking for a Senior Purchasing Operations Associate to support the development and commercialization of our multi-day energy storage technology. You will be responsible for executing Form’s purchases across a variety of goods, services, and vendors, as well as analyzing purchasing and supply chain data. Highly organized and reliable, you will become the central expert to guide, advise, and execute on purchasing activities across the company. You will report to the Sr. Manager of Purchasing and Business Processes within our rapidly-growing Supply Chain organization and will work closely with Finance, Accounting, Engineering, and Operations teams.



This is a hybrid role, which will require working onsite from our office in Weirton, WV or Berkeley, CA 3+ days per week.



Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Support Sourcing activities for manufacturing and facilities supplies, including cost analysis, vendor selection, and contracting needs

 - Support and execute procure-to-pay process for facilities, engineering and other critical departments

 - Centralize, consolidate, and execute regular purchasing needs across multiple supplier accounts using purchase orders, credit cards, or other appropriate methods

 - Support new vendor onboarding to Form’s accounting system to ensure timely and seamless payment processing

 - Find and implement process improvements within the purchasing process, ERP system, and other supply chain functions




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 3+ years professional experience in a purchasing, sourcing, or inventory management role

 - Highly organized, attentive to detail, reliable, and proactive

 - Ability to multitask, prioritize efforts, and effectively communicate progress and issues

 - Familiarity with common business software and purchasing systems (e.g. Google and Microsoft applications, Quickbooks, Coupa, Oracle)

 - Bachelors degree or equivalent in applicable work experience

description:

These businesses sell windows, doors, siding, roofing, decking and other exterior building products. Understanding how they generate leads, how they sell in the home, and how they deliver the complete homeowner experience will be critical to your success.
You will become an integral part of your customers' businesses, serving as the connector between our specialty dealers, distributors, sales teams and internal resources. You will help partners grow through product knowledge, training, business support, and access to the right people across Fortune Brands.
This is a highly visible, relationship-driven role for someone who understands the repair and remodel channel, knows how specialty dealers operate, and can turn strong partnerships into measurable growth. Develop and execute a market strategy focused on growing Fortune Brands Outdoors products within the repair and remodel specialty dealer channel.
Build strong relationships with specialty dealers and partners that sell building products directly to homeowners, including organizations using in-home and showroom-based selling models, and develop new dealer relationships while expanding business with existing partners.
Serve as a trusted business partner and primary connector for customers, helping them navigate Fortune Brands resources, products, programs, distribution and internal teams.
Partner closely with dealers, distributors and internal sales teams to identify growth opportunities, remove barriers, and expand product adoption and market share.
Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business model, sales process, market and growth strategy, to find the places where Fortune Brands can add real value.
Deliver product education, sales training and ongoing support so dealer partners can confidently position and sell our products to homeowners.
Facilitate communication and collaboration between customers, distributors, territory sales teams, product teams, marketing and other internal partners.
Maintain a strong presence in the market through regular customer visits, field engagement, and participation in relevant dealer and industry events.
Track opportunities, customer activity and business performance, and own the growth number for your assigned market.
5+ years of sales, business development, or account management experience within building products, home improvement, repair and remodel, or a related industry.
Experience with building products such as windows, doors, siding, roofing, decking, or other exterior home improvement products and knowledge of the 2-step distribution process.
Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with business owners, sales leaders, dealer partners, distributors and other channel stakeholders.
Experience delivering product education, sales training, or other customer-facing support that helps partners grow their business.
The ability to act as a liaison and facilitator across multiple stakeholders, connecting customers with the right resources and driving issues through to resolution.
Strong business acumen, including the ability to understand how your customers make money and where mutual growth is available.
The ability to independently manage a large geographic territory with significant field travel.
Valid State Driver's License.

Direct experience with in-home selling, specialty dealers, home improvement contractors, or businesses that sell building products directly to homeowners, including a strong understanding of how those dealers generate leads, sell, install and service products in the residential repair and remodel market.
Background in contract negotiation within the building materials or construction industry.
Experience managing or contributing to P&L accountability within a sales or business development role.

title: Supply/Demand Planner
description:
Job Description:
About Us:
ITW Car Care is a division of Illinois Tool Works (ITW), specializing in automotive aftermarket products. The division offers a diverse portfolio of brands such as Rain-X wiper blades, visibility enhancing products, and water-repellent treatments, including our 2-in-1 Glass Cleaner. Black Magic to support all your wheel and tire needs including Tire Wet.
Position Summary:
We are hiring two Supply/Demand Planners, with opportunities at either the Planner I or Planner II level based on experience.
These roles are responsible for balancing Finished Goods (FG), Semi-Finished Goods (SFG), and Raw Materials (RM) with customer demand through forecasting, supply planning, and cross-functional collaboration. The planners will partner with suppliers, manufacturing sites, and sales teams to achieve service, inventory, and MOH targets. Planner II candidates will also take ownership of end-to-end material planning and provide guidance to less experienced planners.
Key Responsibilities:
Demand Planning
Build and maintain statistical demand forecasts.
Track Point of Sale (POS) data and adjust the forecast to reflect changes in demand.
Bring forecast inputs to demand planning meetings with Sales and Marketing.
Supply Planning & Purchasing
Run long-term and short-term planning for Finished Goods (FG), Semi-Finished Goods (SFG/SM) and Raw Materials (RM).
Purchase FG, SFG and RM, and coordinate supplier deliveries so products arrive on time.
Calculate Market Rate of Demand (MRD) requirements for suppliers. Maintain and update the MRD system using Run Rates (RR), Lead Times (LT) and batch sizes.
Run Material Requirements Planning (MRP) in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system to plan material and production needs.
Plan manufacturing production, working with the plants on schedules and capacity.
Inventory & Performance Management
Calculate and report key planning metrics:
- Months on Hand (MOH)
- Obsolete and Slow-Moving Inventory (OSMI)
- On-Time In-Full (OTIF)
- Run Rate (RR) and Safety Stock (SS)
- Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)
- Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
Analyze inventory data and recommend actions to improve Months on Hand (MOH).
Recommend and make planning parameter changes: Lead Times (LT), minimum inventory, lot sizes and order policies.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and Excel reports to track inventory and service performance.
Take part in supplier and manufacturing site meetings, and support the monthly Inventory Management meeting.
Apply 80/20 principles to focus planning effort on the products and customers that matter most.
Planner II Scope (in addition to the above)
Independently own the full MRD and MRP process for an assigned product portfolio.
Train and mentor Planner I team members.
Lead small improvement projects in planning and sourcing.
Qualifications:
Required
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business, or a related field.
Planner I: 0–3 years of experience in supply chain, procurement or supplier coordination.
Planner II: 3–6 years of experience, including a track record of independently managing sourcing or planning projects
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large data sets.
Experience with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems and Material Requirements Planning (MRP) processes.
Preferred
Experience in manufacturing or production planning.
Familiarity with Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) / Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and 80/20 methodology.
APICS/ASCM certification: Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM) or Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP).
Technical Skills
Advanced Microsoft Excel: pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, advanced formulas and data modeling.
Power BI: building dashboards and reports for inventory, forecast and service metrics.
MRP / ERP systems: running Material Requirements Planning and maintaining planning parameters.
MRD: maintaining MRD calculations and system updates.
Statistical forecasting methods and tools.
Key Competencies
Analytical thinking and attention to detail
Clear communication with suppliers, manufacturing sites and commercial teams
Takes ownership and follows through
Continuous improvement mindset
Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Primarily performs work in an office environment with frequent use of a computer, telephone, and other standard office equipment.
Requires prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer, including extensive use of a keyboard, mouse, and multiple software applications.
Frequently communicates with suppliers, manufacturing facilities, sales teams, and other stakeholders via phone, video conference, and email.
Must be able to review, analyze, and interpret large amounts of data and reports, requiring close visual acuity and sustained concentration.
Occasionally required to stand, walk, reach, bend, stoop, and move throughout office and manufacturing environments.
May occasionally lift, carry, push, or pull materials and office equipment weighing up to 15 pounds.
Ability to travel occasionally to manufacturing sites, supplier locations, or company meetings as business needs require.
Must be able to operate in both office and plant environments, including exposure to varying noise levels and production activities during site visits.
Work Environment
Work is performed primarily in a professional office setting with periodic visits to manufacturing and warehouse facilities.
During plant visits, appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required in accordance with site safety policies.
Position may require flexibility to support multiple manufacturing facilities, suppliers, and time zones to ensure uninterrupted supply chain operations.

title: Design Control Engineer 3
description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
The Design Control Engineer contributor within the Product Quality organization, responsible for
supporting the design and development of safe, effective, and compliant medical device products.
The Design Controls Engineer is responsible for assisting and training Design Engineering and New Product
Introduction teams with their regulatory and quality documentation deliverables in support of Design
Control milestones and DHF maintenance. You will be responsible for direct user support in addition to
content development and training delivery for Design Controls tools. As process and tools experts, the
Design Controls Engineer also assists users with complex documentation activities supporting regulatory
submissions and investigations. As a Risk Management and Design Controls expert, the Design Controls
Engineer assists users on data governance, compliance (including GDP), and quality assurance of DHF
documentation used for regulatory submissions and audit.
Essential Job Duties
Provide coaching and mentorship to development, manufacturing, and other stakeholders oncontent development, quality processes, risk analysis and Design Controls tools
Work with ALM developers to identify and capture learning content for tool features including best practices
Develop content for, review, and effectively deliver training to optimize efficacy and learner experience through channels such as online learning modules, instructor-led training, written instructional solutions, short content videos, and virtual training for users of Design Control tools
Respond to ticket-based requests from a variety of user channels supporting design teams
Research, recommend, and implement new authoring tools to improve learner experience
Monitor effectiveness of learning programs and materials and augment training content based on user feedback.
Provide user feedback to the new product/feature development team to ensure user adoption of new features
Drive standardization of design control documents via stakeholder engagement meetings while
ensure Good Documentation Practices (GDP) are followed
Be an ECO mentor for document ECO creator qualification, while regularly identifying new candidates to nominate for ECO document creator access
The following job duties are secondary and will decrease over time with wider tool adoption and
increased user skills:
Assist the new product development team with compiling and updating documents for Design History Files, including risk analyses, requirements, trace reports, and design verification and validation test documentation
Build, produce, and refine complex trace reports using standard report templates.
Create additional custom reports as needed
Assist subject matter experts with writing, reviewing, and/or editing documents required by Intuitive’s design control process
In some cases, help author and deliver documentation and Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) related to complex documentation (e.g. complex risk analysis documents) for major design reviews
Required Skills and Experience
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science or other technical area
Minimum of 3 years of experience in a technical field, medical devices preferred
Stay current on medical devices standards for Risk Management (ISO 14971) Design Controls (ISO 13485) and FDA design control requirements (21 CFR Part 820)
Experience working in an ISO 13485 medical device product development environment or other regulated industry
Experience writing and reviewing Engineering and manufacturing (design control) documents,
including risk analysis, requirements, specifications, test protocols and test reports
Skilled in the use of Agile or similar product lifecycle management (PLM) system tool
